Lina (ML Eng): quick heads-upwe're seeing a small but consistent quality dip on the new q4b build when evaluated on the code/deid promptset. not massive, but concentrated on backtick/case-sensitive tokens. tagging @Marco @Sam @Rey
Marco (Curation): can you share the repro slice and which normalizer/tokenizer versions were used?
Lina (ML Eng): pushing a 300 example repro to gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/repro_300.jsonl. baseline used tokenizer v2.1 + whitespace_norm v1.2; new infra used tokenizer v2.2 + whitespace_norm v1.3
Sam (Annot Ops): i'll prioritize the golden overlap first (n=65). labelers want both q4b and fp16 outputs in each batch. batch size 15. ETA 18h
Rey (Quant): likely token-split boundary + int4 rounding. propose: 1) run token_diff on repro slice; 2) run a q8 fallback on top-25 most frequent prompts; 3) capture per-token logits for top-30 divergent items
CI-Bot: queued dedupe job dedupe-3901 on repro_300.jsonl with fuzzyhash_v2. Logs: gs://ci-logs/dedupe-3901.log
Marco (Curation): running canonicalizer diff now: `tools/normalize/canon_diff.py --from v1.2 --to v1.3 repro_300.jsonl`
CI-Bot: dedupe finished: 300 -> 278 after fuzzyhash_v2. canon_diff shows 12 items with changed fingerprint (mostly backtick normalization).
Sam (Annot Ops): relabel job lbl-9901 started for 65 golden items. note: include rubric addendum: treat punctuation-only inside code fences as non-halluc unless semantics change.
Rey (Quant): token_diff and logits snapshot posted: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/token_diffs.jsonl and gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/logits_top30.jsonl. early signal: rare delimiters and mixed-case identifiers unstable under q4b
Lina (ML Eng): running a targeted quant profile toggling perchannel on layers 6-11 and a small embedding clip. will post results shortly
CI-Bot: relabel lbl-9901 completed: 65/65. summary: 9 items unanimous as model hallucination, 4 GT corrections. details: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/relabel_summary.csv
Marco (Curation): propose micro-golden: add 9 negative checks + 4 replacements; tag provenance `golden_qbringup_3901234567`, include normalizer/tokenizer versions. will stage patch after Lina posts quant results
Rey (Quant): targeted profile reduced hallucination on the 9 items by ~55% vs q4b baseline, latency +1.2%. report: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/quant_profile_report.md
Lina (ML Eng): thanks. Marco please stage micro-golden patch with minimal churn. Sam please start 10-day daily sample monitoring of the code/deid route (n=40/day).
Sam (Annot Ops): done, monitoring plan in gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3901234567/monitor_plan.md
Lina (ML Eng): filing RFC for fallback policy if micro-golden holds. thanks all :thumbsup:
CI-Bot: thread archived.
